payload.edge_summary: Exploit persistent positive risk premia in a small, low-correlated universe by overweighting the highest Sharpe asset (a03, Sharpe 1.67, max_dd -17.7%) and diversifying across five other positive-Sharpe names (a04, a07, a01, a10, a02), while excluding three assets with near-zero or negative expected returns (a06 Sharpe 0.04 max_dd -74%, a09 Sharpe 0.00 max_dd -110%, a08 Sharpe -0.37). Cross-asset correlations are uniformly low (max |ρ|=0.18), so diversification is genuine and portfolio vol scales sublinearly.
payload.reasoning: SIZING RULE: target weights as above; quantity = floor(cash * weight / current_price); residual cash kept as 10% buffer. REBALANCE CADENCE: every 10 trading days, drift-tolerant — only rebalance if any single asset drifts more than 5pp from target. KILL-SWITCH: if cumulative portfolio drawdown exceeds 15%, halve all position sizes (exposure to ~45%); if drawdown exceeds 25%, liquidate to cash and stay flat for at least 5 bars before re-entering at half-target exposure. EXCLUSIONS: a06, a08, a09 are structurally excluded — a06 and a09 have catastrophic max_dd (-74%, -110%) with near-zero Sharpe, a08 has negative expected return. REGIME CLASSIFICATION: long-biased quality tilt, exploiting low cross-correlation and persistent positive mean returns in the top six assets. The 10% cash reserve provides dry powder for re-deployment after drawdowns. EDGE SOURCE: cross-sectional Sharpe dispersion (1.67 vs -0.37) combined with near-zero pairwise correlations means equal-risk-contribution is dominated by a03 and the portfolio benefits from genuine diversification that simple 1/N weighting ignores.
